traits: Every cut is a hard cut: scenes change in a single frame, with no dissolve, wipe or push.
Nothing overshoots or bounces; elements arrive crisp and stop on their mark.
Text is revealed by mask or word-by-word, and a number counts up to its value.
Scenes rest for more than a second after the last arrival, so a claim sits still beside its evidence.

notLike.line: kinetic shares the entrances but bounces and uses push and whip-pan; proof stays flat and hard-cuts every scene.
calm is as still but dissolves between scenes; proof cuts.

nativeMoves.move: Claim, then evidence on the next hard cut: a statement holds, the frame cuts, and the number or screenshot that backs it fills the frame.
nativeMoves.transfer: A security audit film where each finding is stated, then cut to the log line that shows it.

nativeMoves.move: A counting figure that lands without overshoot, so the final number is the exact value on screen.
nativeMoves.transfer: A clinical results film where the response rate counts up and stops on the reported figure.

nativeMoves.move: Mask-reveal on a caption so a source line is uncovered beneath a figure.
nativeMoves.transfer: A budget walkthrough where each line item is followed by its source document title.

pitfalls.mistake: Adding a transition effect to soften a cut.
pitfalls.mechanism: The hard cut is the register of the style; a dissolve says presentation, not evidence.
pitfalls.fix: Leave every cut hard; shorten the preceding hold if it feels abrupt.

pitfalls.mistake: Letting a figure overshoot its value.
pitfalls.mechanism: A counter that passes the number and returns shows a wrong value for a moment, which undermines a proof.
pitfalls.fix: Keep overshoot at zero and the count ease monotonic.

pitfalls.mistake: Filling a scene with six arrivals at once.
pitfalls.mechanism: The claim and its evidence compete, and the viewer cannot tell which is which.
pitfalls.fix: One claim and one piece of evidence per scene.

free: Which entrance carries each text role (mask-reveal, words or rise).
How long a claim holds before the cut, from 1.2 seconds up.
Which evidence form follows the claim: figure, screenshot or quote.
Whether the sound bed is soft or silent.
invariants: Every transition is a hard cut.
Counted figures stop on their exact value.
Arrivals stay between three and nine per ten seconds.
